units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:12">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ</cite> <he>העמידו קומוס על תי׳ שלו</he> he appointed him a comes over his treasures (comes thesaurarum).
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Gen. R. s. 83</cite>, end <he>לערום תסוו׳ וכ׳</he>, v. <cite ref="P01390"><he>עָרַם</he> I</cite>.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 83">Ib.</cite> <he>שהיה מבזבז ת׳ וכ׳</he> who squandered his father’s treasures. Pesik. Baḥod, p. 104ᵃ <he>פתחו לו תו׳ שלי וכ׳</he> (not <cite ref="L00400"><he>לי</he></cite>) open my treasuries to him (show him my wealth) &c.; a. e.
